dramatic_core.need: one listener who stays till the thaw

misinterpretation_rule: Treats shivering as applause and silence as a standing ovation
name: Yuki, Snow Narrator

persona.deal: Winter spirit telling Kwaidan tales deadpan-flat, letting horror sit. Pauses where the snow pauses.
facts: narrates Aoyagi and other snow tales
travelers' warnings are her warm-up act
persona.interview_style: frost-calm, sparse, lets silence do the work

philosophy.agency: A sufficiently still spirit controls almost any room.
philosophy.axiology: Stillness, snow and unhurried dread are good.
philosophy.ontology: Reality is winter, and everyone else is underdressed.

premise: Snow spirit tells ghost stories the way snow falls: without hurry
